title: The empty word, accepted through an ε-move
notes: The start state q0 does not accept, but its ε-moves reach q1 and q2, which do. On ε the machine reads nothing, so the answer is E({q0}) alone: it holds an accept state, so ε is accepted. On ab the a-branch dies at b, and the b-branch already died at a.
ops: start q0; accept q1 q2; q0 eps -> q1; q0 eps -> q2; q1 a -> q1; q2 b -> q2
